items.title: The chat follows a card grown by its dice
items.do: With the chat at its bottom, Sylwen makes a Weapon Attack on the Orc Warrior and clicks Damage; then Apply. Then scroll up a little and click Damage on another card.
items.expect: After Damage (the dice landed) the card's last line is in sight; after Apply too. Scrolled up before clicking, it stays where you are.

items.title: Empowered on a Save Action: by hand in the dialog too
items.do: Durgan without the Empowered condition, on his turn, uses Word of Radiance on two enemies and turns on Empowered in the roll dialog by hand (the Damage row's Empowered); then once with the condition but its chip switched off.
items.expect: By hand: before the Saves the HUD asks which creature takes the 1d6!, and a chat line says who. With its chip switched off: nothing is asked and no die is added.

items.title: The movement that triggers a Reaction, on the map
items.do: The Orc Warrior drags 3 squares past Aveline (Rebuke can trigger) and stops.
items.expect: The Orc's exact path is a pale line through each square, a dot on each, an arrow where it ended, its faint picture where it started; the square where Rebuke can come is outlined in gold with a plate "Reaction here / Rebuke"; no dashed squares.

items.title: A push from a Large creature
items.do: The Ogre Chieftain (Large) pushes Durgan with Overhead Smash's Pushed 2; hover the squares, then one into a wall.
items.expect: No big white circle around the Ogre; the squares to click in gold, Durgan's path with an arrow above the tokens; a short plate "Pushed 2" (into the wall: "Collision after 1: 2 Vigor").

items.title: Move back gives back only the last movement
items.do: In a combat, the Ogre Chieftain drags 1 square, then drags again toward Kaela (Slip Away triggers on the second drag); on the Reactions card click Move back all the way (Shift-click). Then once a drag that buys an Advance (1 AP) and Move back all the way.
items.expect: The Ogre goes back to where the second drag started, and only the second drag's squares come back (the first square stays spent). A drag that bought its Advance: back where it started with its AP and squares as before that drag.

items.title: A Large creature passing a creature: the ruler counts it
items.do: Make Durgan Large (2 × 2); in a combat, drag him straight past the Goblin Sneak so his space slides along its square for two steps; watch the ruler while dragging; drop; read the HUD's squares left. Then a drag where only one step overlaps.
items.expect: The ruler's label reads "(+2)" for the two steps alongside ("(+1)" for one), and the squares spent match it. If it still doesn't, send the ruler's screenshot as before.

items.title: Judge's question for the GM, and Line of Effect
items.do: As the GM with no token selected, the Judged Orc Warrior damages an ally near Durgan (Durgan an NPC-run Paladin, or the GM answering for him): click Durgan's token. Then a wall between Durgan and the ally.
items.expect: The question moves into Durgan's HUD, Situational tab (not a small floating bar). With the wall (no Line of Effect from Durgan to the ally) no question and no reduction.

items.title: The Situational section's order and the area's question
items.do: Sylwen is Prone; she uses an area Action (Volley) and places it.
items.expect: The area's question ("Volley: apply the area shown on the map? …", capitalized) is above Prone's Stand / Crawl; no "Right-click pans the map" in any key line.

items.title: Armor of Faith's names as text
items.do: Durgan at Escalation 2 uses Shield of Faith on Aveline when the Orc Warrior's Strike would damage her.
items.expect: The chat line reads "Armor of Faith (Durgan's Passive, for using Shield of Faith): Durgan gains Guard 3" with the two names in bold, a dotted underline, no box; a click opens each card.

items.title: Two Paladins Judge the same Orc: the breakdown
items.do: Aveline and Durgan both Judge one Orc; it damages an ally near both; both reduce; apply, then open the row's breakdown (the equals button).
items.expect: Each Paladin is asked; the breakdown lists "Judge (Aveline) −N" and "Judge (Durgan) −N", then any Guard it took; no "Cannot read properties of null" in the console.

items.title: Rescue stays within your Reach
items.do: Durgan uses Hold the Line's Rescue on an adjacent ally (Aveline): try to move her 2 squares away from him, then to another square next to him.
items.expect: Only the squares within Durgan's Reach are offered (the gold squares); a square farther away says "the target must remain within Durgan's Reach (1)"; a square next to him works.

items.title: The hover card: overlapping areas, in sections
items.do: Aveline's Consecrated Ground overlapping Sylwen's Covering Fire; hover a square in both.
items.expect: Both areas, each under its bold name, separated by a line; each one's lines in sections: "Enemies" (Difficult Terrain), "Allies and you" (Guard equal to your Power Modifier at the start of their turns), then its rounds.

items.title: Covering Fire, Volley, Spotter
items.do: Sylwen places Covering Fire and the GM walks an enemy in; she uses Volley on a 3 Burst; she Calls Out (Spotter) a creature in Dim light.
items.expect: The enemy takes [V] 2 + Weapon Modifier and pays double; Volley makes Prone on a Critical; your allies see the called-out creature Clear for 1 round.

items.title: Clear Lines and Opening Shot
items.do: Sylwen at Escalation 4 (Clear Lines) shoots past Aveline at an Orc Engaged with Durgan; then Kaela (Opening Shot) lands a Tier 3.
items.expect: No Cover from your ally and no Field Bane; the Tier 3 line names your allies who threaten the target.

items.title: Hazardous Terrain once per turn-cycle
items.do: Sylwen places Covering Fire; the GM moves an Orc into it (Advance), moves it again inside it in the same turn, and ends its turn there.
items.expect: One hit only (on entering); none for the second move or the end of the turn; it can be hit again from its next turn.

items.title: Thrill of the Kill and Kindled Wrath
items.do: An enemy Sylwen damaged goes Down; Durgan, an ally of Aveline, becomes Bloodied.
items.expect: The Archer's Escalation +1; the Paladin's Escalation +1 (once).

items.title: Thrill of the Kill on a first hit
items.do: Sylwen's first damage on an Orc brings it Down; later, Aveline, whom Sylwen hit with a Volley, goes Down.
items.expect: The kill raises her Escalation; the ally's Down doesn't.

items.title: Damage to allies and numbered names
items.do: In a fight with two Goblin Sneaks, Sylwen's Volley hits Aveline and the Goblins; open the Encounter Log.
items.expect: The damage table has a "To allies" column (damage to itself counts there); the Goblins are "Goblin Sneak 1" and "Goblin Sneak 2" in the window and in the copied text.
